description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'TestCase' that extends PHPUnit's base TestCase. It provides utility methods for testing, such as setting and getting protected/private attributes and invoking protected/private methods of objects, to facilitate testing of classes through reflection.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending PHPUnit's TestCase, providing helper methods for reflection-based testing.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a private or protected attribute of an object or class instance via reflection.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a private or protected attribute's value from an object or class via reflection.

methods.name: invokeMethod
methods.description: Calls a private or protected method of an object with specified parameters via reflection.
